settings.heading: From photo to coffee mug
settings.subheading: You see exactly what we print before you order.

settings.question: Which pets are welcome?
settings.answer: Dogs, cats, and the other animals you call family. Use a clear photo with one pet and its full face visible.

settings.question: How does personalization work?
settings.answer: Upload a photo of your pet. We turn it into an illustrated portrait with the background removed. Choose a style and background, add a name and your own text, pick a size and color, then approve your preview and add it to your cart.

settings.question: Will my mug look like the preview?
settings.answer: Yes. We print the exact design you approve, on both sides of the mug: the same portrait, background, name, text and placement. Colors can look slightly different on ceramic than on a screen.

settings.question: How do I care for my mug?
settings.answer: Hand washing keeps the print bright for longest. See Product details for this mug’s dishwasher and microwave care.

settings.question: What makes a great pet photo?
settings.answer: Bright, even light and a sharp image work best. Keep the camera at your pet’s eye level with the full face and ears visible, and nothing covering your pet.

settings.question: Can I change my design after adding it to the cart?
settings.answer: Yes, until you check out. Edit it on this page and add the new version, then remove the old one from your cart. Each version gets its own design ID.

settings.question: What if I need to change an order?
settings.answer: Contact us as soon as you notice a mistake and include your order number. Changes depend on whether production has already started.

settings.question: What if an item arrives damaged or incorrect?
settings.answer: Contact us with your order number and clear photos. We review production defects, printing issues, broken mugs and incorrect items under the store’s refund and replacement policy.
